actions.name: notify_send
actions.description: Send an alert to the user right now: desktop popup (notify-send, default), a wall broadcast to every logged-in terminal, or a spoken announcement (espeak); message required. silent:true stores it in the inbox without showing it (retrieve later with notify_list); speak:true additionally synthesizes and plays audio via the tts plugin, best-effort.

provider.description: Delivery provider. notify-send: libnotify desktop notification; wall: broadcast to all logged-in terminals; espeak: spoken alert via espeak-ng (falls back to espeak). Ignored when silent is true.

title.description: Notification title. Optional; capped at 256 bytes. Omitted from the spawned argv when empty.

message.description: Notification body. Required, non-empty, capped at 4096 bytes.

urgency.description: notify-send urgency level. Optional; only sent to notify-send.

timeout_ms.description: notify-send display timeout in milliseconds. Optional; 0 leaves the provider default. Only sent to notify-send.

app_name.description: notify-send app name. Optional; defaults to NOTIFY_PLUGIN_APP_NAME, then 'vynkor'.

silent.description: Store only — no delivery, visible later via notify_list. Requires NOTIFY_PLUGIN_DATA_DIR; provider and speak are ignored.

speak.description: Also synthesize through the tts plugin and play the audio on the host. Best-effort: a failed озвучка never fails the delivery.

id.description: Inbox entry id (empty when the inbox is unavailable).

stored.description: True when the notification was stored without delivery (silent path).

provider.description: Canonical provider id the message was delivered through.

detail.description: Trimmed stdout of the delivery binary (empty when the binary prints nothing).

spoken.description: True when the tts озвучка succeeded.

speak_error.description: tts озвучка failure message; empty when spoken is true or speak was not requested.

actions.name: notify_providers
actions.description: List the three notification delivery backends (notify-send, wall, espeak) and whether each is enabled/installed right now — check before notify_send to pick a working provider.

available.description: True when enabled by NOTIFY_PLUGIN_ENABLED_PROVIDERS and its binary is installed.

description.description: One-line description of what the provider does.

actions.name: notify_list
actions.description: List stored notifications from this plugin's inbox, newest first, including past silent notifications; include_read to also show ones already marked read. Requires NOTIFY_PLUGIN_DATA_DIR to be configured.

actions.name: notify_mark_read
actions.description: Mark one stored inbox notification (by id from notify_list or a notify_send response) as read; returns updated:false if it was already read or didn't exist.

id.description: Inbox entry id from notify_list or a notify_send response.

updated.description: True when the entry existed and was unread.

actions.name: notify_delete
actions.description: Permanently remove one stored inbox notification by id (from notify_list or a notify_send response); returns deleted:false if it didn't exist. Only affects the local inbox record, not anything already delivered/displayed.

id.description: Inbox entry id from notify_list or a notify_send response.

actions.name: push_send
actions.description: Push a notification to an external ntfy or gotify server over the network (host must be on the NOTIFY_PLUGIN_PUSH_SERVERS allowlist, default ntfy.sh) so it reaches a phone/other device subscribed to that topic; distinct from notify_send, which only alerts this machine.

server.description: Push server host[:port]; must be on NOTIFY_PLUGIN_PUSH_SERVERS. Defaults to the allowlist's first entry (ntfy.sh).

topic.description: ntfy topic. Required for ntfy, forbidden for gotify.

NOTIFY_PLUGIN_APP_NAME.description: Default app name shown by notify-send when a request omits app_name.

NOTIFY_PLUGIN_ENABLED_PROVIDERS.description: Comma-separated list of enabled providers (notify-send, wall, espeak). Empty = all enabled. A provider not on the list is rejected at call time and reported unavailable by notify_providers.

NOTIFY_PLUGIN_DATA_DIR.description: Directory for the notification inbox (inbox.json). Required only for silent notifications / notify_list / notify_mark_read / notify_delete; normal deliveries work without it and just skip the store.

NOTIFY_PLUGIN_TTS_PROVIDER.description: tts provider for speak: true (passed to the tts plugin's tts_synthesize).

NOTIFY_PLUGIN_TTS_VOICE.description: Optional tts voice id; the voice key is omitted from the tts request when unset or empty.

NOTIFY_PLUGIN_TTS_FORMAT.description: tts output container format for speak: true (wav, mp3, ogg, ...). pcm is not directly playable.

NOTIFY_PLUGIN_AUDIO_PLAYER.description: Audio player binary for speak (paplay/pw-play/aplay for wav; ffplay for mp3/ogg). Default: auto-detect.
